notched-v1.reference: a new run in the v0.2.0-base checkout
notched-v1.reference_command: python -m campaigns.notched_v1.s13 train --run-root <new> --stop-after 400 (in the v0.2.0-base checkout)

reason: the registered step-400 checkpoints were trained on Linux/AVX512; trained weights depend on the CPU instruction set (ADR 0100 decision 5 and findings: the owner machine, Linux/AVX2, gives model state 9492c444... for the S13c recipe at step 400, against e45edbdc... registered), so a replay on the owner machine cannot reproduce the registered tensors whatever the code
registered_profile: the registered AVX512 model-state hashes of S24-PROTOCOL.json are reported beside each record and required only on that profile
rule: on the owner machine, a 400-step run of each family's registered recipe at the S24-or-later revision equals a 400-step run of the same recipe at the v0.2.0 base revision on the same machine: every tensor of model.safetensors and state.safetensors equal, optimizer.json and adaptive.json byte-identical, manifest fields equal except run_hash, model_export_hash and tensor_payload_hash, safetensors metadata equal except run_hash, run bindings equal except implementation_revision; compared by campaigns.s24_replay
